w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
🗣️ Ivy to Sofia, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 5,150 of 14,000 kcal."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: The Wrong Map. The System hands you a map to buried alien rations. Exactly one thing on it is a lie. Find the lie, find the food."

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen from its recent high again — the shelves are thinning.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.
⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Florence returns from the wilds hurt (health 4/100) — the trip cut short.
